known_before_registration: The two query1 means, previous15-control and99-control outcomes, four cached forecasts and post-hoc two-mean ranking are known. The new30-control real replay outcomes have not been read before this protocol. This is a targeted diagnostic, not an independent confirmation or a new attack.

selection.definition: Exactly the same two original returned H6 means, goal and four complete cached forecasts used in the registered two-mean ranking. No new candidate, magnitude, seed, weight, objective or endpoint selection.

dependency_gate: Do not start until the new replay summary is terminal-completed, both original means were replayed for30 controls from the qualified same root, and both first15-control prefixes exactly reproduce the existing native traces/observations. Require explicit schema/qualification checks; absent or failed evidence invalidates the diagnostic, with no new truth encoding.

replay_interface.endpoint_schema: pixels:uint8[1,3,224,224];proprio:float32[1,4];control_offset:scalar15or30. Add one leading axis for native batch1/T1 encode.
replay_interface.provenance: Interface confirmed by replay implementer before any new30-control result was read.

execution_order: Read the completed qualified replay and existing caches; verify original means, same goal/context, actual offsets15/30 and observed15 pixels/proprio against the older cache. No model or environment is needed for these checks.
Query actual GPU0 free memory. If below3072MiB, stop resource_deferred without loading weights or waiting. Set this process's Torch allocator cap to2GiB, not a total-process reservation.
Load each of the two existing checkpoint files once with the established native loader, strict state checks and identical GPU FP32 backend. No downloads, training or predictor calls.

Calibration only: encode the original cached goal once, then each candidate's actual control15 endpoint once. Compare goal to saved native goal features and control15 to the previously calibrated same-GPU truth features. All visual/proprio and per-timepoint gates must pass before any control30 truth encoding. Stop immediately on failure, retaining diagnostics.

Only after all3 observation calibrations pass, encode each candidate's actual control30 endpoint once. Total at most5 native encodes, batch1/T1 throughout. No additional encodes or counterfactual model forecasts.

Compute the four fixed terminal forecast errors from cached original/canonical index6 versus the corresponding actual control30 feature. Compute the two actual-future feature costs with the unchanged native objective on CPU FP32. Look up physical utilities from actual replay; never replace them with feature scores.

calibration.rule: Reuse numerical_comparison unchanged: allclose AND maximum bound AND RMS bound, for visual/proprio and every timepoint. Do not relax the failed earlier CPU diagnostic or silently use a backend fallback.
calibration.failure: invalid_numerical_calibration; zero30-control truth encodes and null terminal-error/ranking conclusion. Preserve the failed attempt.

metrics.forecast_error: For each of2 candidates and2 representations: terminal visual MSE, proprio MSE and visual+0.1*proprio MSE. Use float64 arithmetic over frozen FP32 arrays, matching the previous diagnostic.
metrics.true_future_objective: Call native ReprTargetDistMPCObjective on each actual control30 encoded observation and the unchanged original goal; CPU FP32, alpha0.1, sum_all_diffs=false, original candidate actions passed unchanged. Minimize; exact ties choose clean_identity_copy. These are true-future feature costs, not physical utility.
metrics.physical_utility: Report actual30-control cumulative reward, terminal native reward/reach distance, final and ever success, first success or null and successful-control count from replay. Preserve disagreement between dense reward, terminal state and success metrics. Do not invent a single composite utility or new pass threshold.
metrics.relation: Report whether the true-future feature objective selects the lower actual30-step cumulative-return candidate and separately the lower actual terminal-reward candidate; ties and success metrics remain separate. Compare with both already measured cached-forecast rankings without regenerating them.
metrics.limits: One post-hoc two-mean bank at a common query1 root. This closes its30-control truth horizon only; no reconstruction of all native CEM candidates, no99-step causal mediation, no population ASR, and no proof of training-distribution membership or new security novelty.

runtime.resource_failure: Preserve resource_deferred on startup shortage, OOM or wall limit; no waiting, model change, threshold relaxation or other-job modification.

preservation: New run directory and report only; refuse existing outputs. Save launched protocol/script and encoded arrays. Do not modify prior protocols/results, registry or HTML.
